verdict.rationale: Okta's own docs show that it drives user provisioning to connected apps over SCIM, including a RESTful API for CRUD operations on user resources. That implies it can push deprovisioning to downstream apps, but the evidence never describes the deactivation flow itself. Nothing shows a single deactivate action that revokes sessions or deprovisions every connected app immediately. missing for 10: documented user-deactivation flow, session revocation on deactivate, evidence of automatic deprovisioning across all connected apps, timing/immediacy guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
